calibration_policy_memo.content: Calibration Policy v3.2 (effective 2026-01-15): Instruments must be scheduled for calibration no later than 10 business days before Next Due. A documented HOLD or OVERRIDE from the QA lead supersedes the spreadsheet Next Due date and removes the instrument from the auto-scheduling list until lifted. Out-of-service and already-arranged instruments are excluded. All new tracking tasks and lab-manager notifications require operations supervisor sign-off before they are created or sent.
